documentation.description:
Manage data that has to be kept in sync across environments.
  backup-users               Write the users graph to a file.
  restore-users              Replace the users graph with the contents of a file. Destructive.
  update-notification-email  Point every notification address at one address.
 Parameters:
  mu script project-scripts data-sync backup-users [output-file] [endpoint]
  mu script project-scripts data-sync restore-users [input-file] [endpoint] [batch-size]
  mu script project-scripts data-sync update-notification-email <email-address> [endpoint]
Create a local copy of the data/db folder. A name for the backup folder can be optionally passed.
